caption: R550 left and a school form that needs R200 next week. Do you plan for that or just hope?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R8 900
p/m salary
Living in Mdantsane
slides.body:
Female, 35
Single mother, kids aged 12 and 4
Job: Spaza shop assistant
Net salary: R8 900 p/m

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Maize meal, chicken, veg from the stall, Friday takeaway chicken
slides.body: The Friday chicken is R300 a month. I know. The kids look forward to it all week.

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Backyard room, shared tap and yard
slides.body: It is small. The landlord is fair and the room is safe, and in this price range that is rare.

slides.title: School & crèche
slides.body: The crèche fee is the one I pay first. Everything else can wait a week.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My mother in Cofimvaba, her pension doesn't stretch
slides.body: I send it the day I get paid. If I wait, I find a reason to send less.

slides.title: Taxi fare
slides.includes: Work and back, plus the kids' school run
slides.body: The fare went up again. Nobody asked me, but I keep paying it.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Prepaid electricity R450, Airtime & data R150, Funeral policy R200, Stokvel R200
slides.body: Four small things that each feel too small to count. Together they are a whole R1 000.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R8 900. That is about R18 a day for the whole month, if nothing goes wrong. Something usually does.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statement to Beyond Horizon and every transaction was sorted for me.

The takeaway chicken line was smaller than I feared, and the taxi line was bigger.

No bank login needed.
